findings.reason: §1/§1b should give the colour table one owner (plot_style.py, with the script's candidates drawn from it) rather than two copies that drift when the choice changes.
findings.text: the repository's colour-role mapping is owned in two places at once: `DEFAULT_PALETTE` (lines 88-93) and `CANDIDATES["A-blue-vessel"]` (scripts/figures_jt60sa_geometry.py:66-71) are byte-identical, yet §1b keeps `CANDIDATES` in the script as the palette authority and the module keeps the default — so the palette the lead eventually locks and the palette a figure gets by default can diverge silently

findings.reason: the plan's justification for declining the composer (it wants shapes, not a `GeometryTable`) does not require a second open-and-read implementation; §1b should factor that block onto `artifact_geometry.py` (or the catalogue path) so the figure reader and the composer share one acquisition path instead of two that must be kept in step.
findings.text: the geometry script's reader re-implements the acquisition half of `MachineArtifactGeometryReader.read`: both open `pf_active`, `pf_passive`, `wall` and `magnetics` and pass the four structs to the same `read_artifact_*` readers, the script via `_read_ids` (scripts/figures_jt60sa_geometry.py:158) building `phase_dir / f"{ids_name}.nc"` itself — a filename convention owned by `transform_engine._NetCDFStoreArrays.read` (transform_engine.py:288)

findings.reason: the extra sites are per-figure inline styling that §1 explicitly scopes out of restyling, so the over-claim does not change what the plan builds, though the "no style code" sentence should be narrowed to "no style module".
findings.text: §1 asserts "imas_ambix/ holds no plotting style code", but this function sets `plt.rcParams` (spines, grid, dpi, font size) inline, and `scripts/` holds about eighteen figure scripts (`figures_machine_configuration_map.py`, `figures_topology_census.py`, `plot_*.py`, …) of which §1 names only two

duplicate_owner-1.reason: carried in the jtfig-palette-range node contract (done-when): CANDIDATES['A-blue-vessel'] is built from plot_style's default palette so plot_style holds the one copy; plan text left unchanged to end the edit-review cycle on a node-level detail

duplicate_owner-2.reason: restates the v13 duplicate_owner finding already declined: MachineArtifactGeometryReader's acquisition sits inside a nova-artifact resolve and GeometryTable build, and factoring a four-line open-and-read helper into gs/ would widen that package for one figure script; the {ids}.nc name is the one-file-per-IDS store convention the catalogue's static-over-map layout declares

reuse_search-1.reason: the reviewer marks it not plan-changing: inline rcParams in elm_sampling_audit.py and the other figure scripts are per-figure styling the plan scopes out, and plot_style.py is the first style module; narrowing the sentence would cost a review round with no change to what is built

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — `imas_ambix/plot_style.py` hides the base sheet, the role contract and the direct-label helper behind three functions, and the geometry script's `read_phase` hides the store format and the element dispatch behind one call returning one `PhaseGeometry`; neither is a spread of shallow wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the colour-role mapping is owned twice: `imas_ambix/plot_style.py` `DEFAULT_PALETTE` and `scripts/figures_jt60sa_geometry.py` `CANDIDATES["A-blue-vessel"]` carry byte-identical values, and the geometry-figure reader re-implements the acquisition block of `MachineArtifactGeometryReader.read`.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; each section that adds surface names, in its own text, what it retires — §1 "retires and merges nothing" because no existing script draws JT-60SA, §1b adds no option/module/public name, and §3 adds one script with no option and states it "retires or merges nothing, since no script in `scripts/` draws a JT-60SA signal".
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites a search of `imas_ambix/data/`, `imas_ambix/gs/` and `scripts/`, and every mechanism it names was opened and exists: `read_artifact_pf_active`/`_pf_passive`/`_magnetics`/`_limiter` in `imas_ambix/gs/artifact_geometry.py`, `MachineArtifactGeometryReader` at `artifact_geometry.py:726`, `NetCDFTransformEngine.open` at `transform_engine.py:348`, `load_packaged_machine_map` at `machine_map.py:1623`, `description_store_root_path` at `machine_map.py:1006`, and the `eddb.py` addressing helpers.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — `read_channel` is added to `imas_ambix/data/eddb.py`, the module that already owns the cache layout (`channel_path`, `channel_time_path`, `UNIT_ATTR`), and §3 states in its own text why `ZarrTransformEngine.read` cannot serve it (needs a packaged `ChannelBinding`) and returns neither time base nor unit.
